dialect.detail: Classic IBM mainframe-style COBOL with RECORDING MODE F, COMP-3 packed decimal, GOBACK, and FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE; consistent with IBM Enterprise COBOL or similar mainframe environment

purpose.domain_detail: Account management financial reporting — reads account records with credit limits and balances and produces a formatted print report
purpose.summary: This batch program reads account records (ACCT-REC) containing account number, credit limit, balance, and name fields, then writes a formatted financial report (PRINT-LINE) with date headers and columnar account data. It is a straightforward sequential file processing program producing a printed ledger-style report.

notable_features: COMP-3 packed decimal for monetary fields (ACCT-LIMIT, ACCT-BALANCE)
RECORDING MODE F on both FD entries
FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE for dynamic date header
Structured paragraph-based flow without GO TO
PERFORM UNTIL loop with end-of-file flag pattern
ZZ,ZZZ,ZZ9.99 edited numeric picture for currency display
verdict.notes: PROGRAM-ID is CBL0004 but filename is cbl0005.cbl — minor mismatch suggesting this is part of a tutorial series (e.g. IBM COBOL course). No COPY statements or CALLs; self-contained simple program. Author field 'Otto B. Formatted' is a playful tutorial name. Overall structure is consistent with an IBM learning exercise.
